title: Detecting Smad-STAT networks using proximity ligation assay
protocol: Harvest freshly sorted or cultured floating cells such as hematopoietic or immune cells.
Centrifuge at 1500 rpm for 10 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant carefully and wash cells with 2% FBS PBS by centrifuging at 1500 rpm for 10 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant and wash again with PBS by centrifuging at 1500 rpm for 10 min at 4°C.
Culture adherent cells such as dendritic cells or cancer cells on coverslips in culture dishes.
Fix the cells (~2x10^6 cells) with fixation buffer (500 μL) for 15 min at room temperature.
Wash the cells twice with PBS (1 mL in microcentrifuge tubes, volume 1.5 mL) by centrifuging at 1500 rpm for 10 min at room temperature.
Permeabilize the cells with permeabilization buffer (500 μL) for 15 min at room temperature.
Wash the cells twice with PBS by centrifuging at 1500 rpm for 10 min at room temperature.
Prepare thin-layers of fixed cells on Poly-L-Lysine coated slides by centrifugation using a cytospin (1-2x10^5 cells/slide, 800 rpm for 10 min at room temperature).
Draw a circle around the samples with a water-proof pen such as Dako Pen after cytospin centrifugation.
Block the slides by blocking solution for 30 min at 37°C in a humidity chamber.
Tap off the blocking solution carefully from the slides without washing.
Incubate the slides immediately with primary antibodies diluted by the antibody diluent (1:50) overnight at 4°C in a humidity chamber.
Tap off the primary antibody solution from the slides.
Wash the slides twice carefully for 5 min with the wash solution.
Incubate the slides with PLA probes diluted by the antibody diluent for 1 hr at 37°C in a humidity chamber.
Wash the slides twice carefully for 5 min with the wash solution.
Add the Ligation-Ligase solution diluted by high purity water and incubate the slides for 30 min at 37°C in a humidity chamber.
Wash the slides twice carefully for 5 min with the wash solution.
Add the Amplification-Polymerase solution diluted by high purity water and incubate the slides for 100 min at 37°C in the dark humidity chamber.
Wash the slides twice carefully for 5 min with the wash solution.
Remove the remaining wash solution completely using a pipette.

Incubate the slides with the secondary goat anti-rat IgG (H+L) antibody Alexa Fluor® 488 diluted by the antibody diluent at a ratio of 1:1000 for 1 hour at room temperature in the dark humidity chamber.
Wash the slides twice carefully for 5 minutes using the wash solution and remove any remaining wash solution completely with a pipette.
Add the minimal volume of Duolink In Situ Mounting Medium with DAPI for nuclear staining and mounting to the slides.
Cover the slides with cover slips.
Remove air bubbles from the slide by pushing the cover slips carefully.
Store the slide at 4°C in the dark before acquiring images using a confocal microscope.
